 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Oct 28, 2026, 15:50:44 IST SUMMARY Gold and silver prices face another crucial week, with rising oil prices. Gold climbs 0.9%, silver rises 0.8%, platinum up 0.3%. Market participants eye Fed policy meeting for signals. Oil futures fell more than 1% on Tuesday as attention turned to Middle East peace talks. Analysts cut their 2026 gold price forecast for a second straight quarter because of high Treasury yields, a strong US dollar and expectations that rates will stay high for longer, but still expect a recovery in 2027, a Reuters survey shows. 
 Together, a combination of factors is expected to shape the direction of bullion market in the days ahead. Track TOI’s coverage to know which way gold and silver prices are headed: 
 Live Events 
 LIVE RATES · INDIA ⟳ 3:56:04 pm Gold Rate 22K gold/gm ₹ 13,210 Silver Rate price/10gm ₹ 2,200 Platinum Rate price/10gm ₹ 46,770 15:50 (IST) Oct 28 Silver Rate Today in Bengaluru The price of silver in Bangalore today is 220 per gram and 2,20,000 per kilogram. The prices of most of the precious metals, have rallied in the last few months, since the beginning of Jan. This includes the silver prices in Bangalore. Silver and gold tend to do tango and move in the same direction. How they will move in the future is the most important question. 15:15 (IST) Oct 28 Gold Rate Today in Bangaluru Today's gold price in Bangalore stands at 14,395 per gram for 24 karat gold (99.9% purity), 13,195 per gram for 22 karat gold (91.6% purity), and 10,796 per gram for 18 karat gold (75% purity). Bangalore or Bengaluru as it is now called, The gold rate in Bangalore is influenced by a mix of domestic demand and international market factors. In fact, there has been a good demand for gold in Bangalore during the course of the year. If you are buying the precious metal check everyday gold price in Bangalore. Being a major metro city, Bangalore gold prices today closely mirror India gold prices, though minor differences may arise due to local taxes and logistics. 15:00 (IST) Oct 28 Silver Rate Today in Mumbai The price of silver in Mumbai today is 220 per gram and 2,20,000 per kilogram. Silver rates in Mumbai has been lacklustre in the last few years. Ever since the Lehman Brothers crisis erupted, Silver rates shot-up after 2008 and there was a sustained rally. However, in the last few years, it has gone nowhere. Investors have preffered investing in equities, pushing shares to new highs through 2016 and 2017. However, in 2018, gold and silver prices in Mumbai saw some recovery as investors sold shares and purchased gold and silver. 14:36 (IST) Oct 28 Gold Rate Today in Mumbai Today's gold price in Mumbai stands at 14,395 per gram for 24 karat gold (99.9% purity), 13,195 per gram for 22 karat gold (91.6% purity), and 10,796 per gram for 18 karat gold (75% purity). There are shops that are as much as 300 years old and have passed on from generation to generation, who offer you best gold rates. Do check todays gold rate in Mumbai before you buy gold. 14:17 (IST) Oct 28 Silver Rate Today in Delhi Silver Rate in Delhi The price of silver in Delhi today is 220 per gram and 2,20,000 per kilogram. Silver has always remained an attractive investment for the people of Delhi. One of the reasons why there is a huge demand for the metal in Delhi is the fact that the city also has a huge population. In fact, a significant portion of the demand for silver comes from the city. Silver price in Delhi is seeing investment in every form, including utensils, silverware, coins etc. 13:43 (IST) Oct 28 Gold Rate Today in Delhi Gold Rate in Delhi Today's gold price in Delhi stands at 14,410 per gram for 24 karat gold (99.9% purity), 13,210 per gram for 22 karat gold (91.6% purity), and 10,811 per gram for 18 karat gold (75% purity). Gold price in Delhi has been seeing some momentum, since the start of the year. 
 This is because, equity markets took a beating at the start of the year, which pushed investors to invest in safe haven asset like gold. The precious metal may not be a favorite in the last few years, as prices have moved in a tight range. A fall in equity prices at the start of the year, saw some attraction to gold as an investment. We have given todays gold rate in Delhi to those who wish to buy the precious metal.

 Prices of Gold in Noida have been moving in line with prices seen in the National Capital Region. in fact, the last few months we have barely seen gold rates in Noida move higher. There has been stability and this has left investors a little impatient. However, for those in the city who are looking at staying invested in the precious metal, it offers an excellent hedge against inflation.
 12:08 (IST) Oct 28 Gold slips on oil-fuelled inflation fears ahead of Fed meeting Gold prices ticked lower on Wednesday after the previous session's climb of about 1%, as higher oil prices stoked inflation fears while investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision later in the day for clues to the rate outlook. 
 Spot gold was down 0.7% at $4,030.20 per ounce by 0602 GMT. US gold futures for December delivery dropped 0.8% to $4,043.0. 08:32 (IST) Oct 28 Gold loans outstanding rose around 80% year on year to Rs 33,000 crore Gold loans outstanding rose around 80% year on year to Rs 33,000 crore, accounting for about 10% of total loans. Of this, Rs 18,600 crore comprised agricultural gold loans and Rs 2,000 crore MSME gold loans, with the remainder classified as retail gold loans. Management expects gold-backed lending to remain an important component of its agricultural portfolio. 08:31 (IST) Oct 28 Bank of Maharashtra sees limited drought impact as gold-backed farm loans cushion stress Bank of Maharashtra expects limited pressure on asset quality from Maharashtra’s drought, citing the secured nature of a large part of its agricultural portfolio, limited pure crop loan exposure and improving recoveries. Almost the entire Rs 11,000 crore year-on-year increase in agricultural loans was driven by gold-backed lending, while pure crop loans account for about 2% of overall loans, in the brokerage’s assessment. 07:51 (IST) Oct 28 Gold edges higher ahead of Fed policy decision Spot gold rose 0.1% to $4,061.86 per ounce by 0036 GMT, after climbing over 1% and touching a session high of $4,065.55 on Tuesday. US gold futures for December delivery steadied at $4,075.60. 
 Markets await the Fed's policy decision due at 1800 GMT along with the Personal Consumption Expenditures data on Thursday, a key gauge closely watched by the central bank as it targets a 2% inflation rate. 
 07:48 (IST) Oct 28 Silver Rate: Silver Slips 4,000 to 1.98 Lakh Silver prices tumbled below the ₹2 lakh per kg mark for the first time in over 10 months in the national capital on Tuesday, and gold dropped ₹500, as weakness in global bullion markets and a stronger dollar weighed on investors' sentiment. 07:46 (IST) Oct 28 Gold Rate: Gold edges higher Gold prices edged higher on Wednesday after rising about 1% in the previous session, as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision later in the day, where the central bank is widely expected to leave interest rates unchanged. Gold prices edged higher on Wednesday after rising about 1% in the previous session, as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision later in the day, where the central bank is widely expected to leave interest rates unchanged. Spot gold climbed 1% to $4,055.14 per ounce after hitting as low as $3,987.14 earlier in the session. US gold futures for December delivery settled 0.9% higher at $4,074.60 per ounce.
